newsitem.title: THAILAND: Total Access to delist from OTC.
newsitem.headline: Total Access to delist from OTC.

text.p: United Communication Industry Plc said on Friday its Total Access Communication Plc unit has requested a delisting from the Thai over-the-counter board and wants to be listed on the main board instead.
The company said in a statement to the Stock Exchange of Thailand it would assign Phatra Thanakit Plc and Securities One Plc as advisers for the change.
It said it would also seek shareholder approval.
Total Access is also listed on the Singapore stock exchange.
